name: SDK JS Demo App
description: Comprehensive Reachy Mini JS SDK primitives demo.

paragraphs: A comprehensive demo of the @pollen-robotics/reachy-mini-sdk primitives, deployed as a Hugging Face static Space. Modernised port of cduss/webrtcexample onto the host shell pattern — the host owns OAuth + robot picker + top bar, this app focuses on demonstrating SDK calls.
Laid out as two columns: the visual side (live camera + a rigged 3D robot view mirroring the real pose) on the left, the controls on the right; it collapses to a single column on narrow screens.

SDK source: this app pins the stable 1.11.0 release from npm. The Conversation app panel needs the JSON-RPC primitives (rpcCall / onNotification, SDK >= 1.10.0) and a robot daemon v1.10.0+ (the daemon-side relay over the data channel). To test against a local SDK checkout instead, run ./scripts/vendor-sdk.sh . It rebuilds that checkout, packs it as 0.0.0-branch.. into vendor/ and repoints the dependency at it, so the SDK pill in the header reads back the exact commit the app was built against. Re-pin to the npm version when you're done.
